Bank Feed Provider — Edit

The Bank Feed Provider form is used to configure connections to bank data feeds.

Bank feeds automatically import bank transactions from your financial institution.

Name

Enter a descriptive name for this bank feed provider.

This name will appear when connecting bank accounts to automated feeds.

Examples: 'Open Banking API', 'Plaid', 'Yodlee', or your bank's direct feed service.

Endpoint

Enter the API endpoint URL provided by your bank feed service.

This URL is used to establish secure connections for downloading transaction data.

Contact your bank feed provider for the correct endpoint URL and authentication requirements.
